components.label: Viewer/player
components.responsibility: Own playback position and visible playback state.

components.label: Video delivery service
components.responsibility: Expose versioned manifests and authorized media bytes.

components.label: Manifest API
components.responsibility: Authorize access and return one atomically published asset version.

components.label: Immutable media origin
components.responsibility: Store encoded segments and manifests by immutable version.

components.label: Encoding pipeline
components.responsibility: Generate aligned renditions, validate decodability, then publish the manifest pointer.

components.label: CDN edge cache
components.responsibility: Serve version-keyed segments while enforcing signed-request policy.

components.label: Origin shield
components.responsibility: Collapse concurrent misses and bound origin fetch concurrency.

components.label: Playback authorization
components.responsibility: Issue short-lived asset-scoped capabilities; keep authorization out of shared cache keys where safe.

components.label: Adaptive bitrate chooser
components.responsibility: Estimate throughput conservatively and use buffer hysteresis to avoid rapid oscillation.

components.label: Bounded media buffer
components.responsibility: Fetch sequential segments up to explicit time and byte limits.

components.label: Regional placement planner
components.responsibility: Preposition popular immutable versions using capacity and demand budgets.

components.label: Regional media cache
components.responsibility: Own region-local prepositioned copies and verify hashes before advertising them.

components.label: Delivery failover selector
components.responsibility: Choose healthy locations without changing the requested content version.

components.label: Unified playback coordinator
components.responsibility: Own fetching, adaptation, buffering and failover under one playback generation.

requirements.text: Play authorized content with a bounded client buffer and versioned segment identities.
Adapt rendition to measured download throughput and buffer health without promising zero stalls.
Protect origin capacity during misses, demand spikes and regional failures.
Reject corrupt or mismatched media and make publishing, expiry and failover policies explicit.

problem.scope: Video-on-demand with immutable encoded segments and manifests. Compare request-driven CDN fills with regional prepositioning. Live media, DRM implementation and peer-to-peer delivery are outside these authored branches.

provenance.note: Authored interview preparation. Technical references support mechanisms, not the claim that a company asked this question.

references.supports: Variant playlists, segment sequences and client playback semantics.
references.title: HTTP Live Streaming RFC 8216

references.supports: Regional content placement and delivery infrastructure.
references.title: Netflix Open Connect

acceptanceCases.given: One rendition has not finished encoding.
acceptanceCases.then: Keep serving the prior version or unavailable; no published manifest points at missing media.
acceptanceCases.when: A viewer requests the new asset.

acceptanceCases.given: A regional cache has incorrect bytes under the requested segment key.
acceptanceCases.then: Reject/quarantine that copy and retry the same version within a bounded attempt policy.
acceptanceCases.when: Download and validate against the trusted content hash.

acceptanceCases.given: Many viewers request one uncached segment.
acceptanceCases.then: One fill per key runs per shield and global origin admission stays bounded.

acceptanceCases.given: An unentitled viewer requests an already cached segment.
acceptanceCases.then: Deny access despite the cache hit; a capability has asset and expiry scope.

acceptanceCases.given: Downloads complete quickly while playback is paused or seeking.
acceptanceCases.then: Old results are ignored and queued media respects time and byte ceilings.
acceptanceCases.when: Continue completion callbacks from an old generation.

acceptanceCases.given: A region fails midway through playback.
acceptanceCases.then: Continue exact assetVersion and sequence; expose rebuffering if no eligible location meets the deadline.

guarantees: Buffer memory stays bounded and stale seek results cannot alter the current playback.

assumptions: VOD segments are immutable per asset version.
Authorized responses must not be shared across users unless the cache can enforce entitlement.
solutions.chooseWhen: The catalogue is long-tailed and demand is difficult to predict.

invariants: A manifest refers to a single published media version.
stages.question: What does the player request?
stages.reason: Start with a viewer and a coarse video boundary.
stages.title: State playback and media identity

invariants: Do not publish a playlist referencing unavailable segments.
stages.question: Where do media bytes live?
stages.reason: Expand serving into a manifest API and immutable segment storage.
stages.title: Expose manifests and immutable origin

invariants: Publish pointer only after every required rendition passes validation.
stages.question: When can a new version become visible?
stages.reason: Separate costly rendition generation from request serving.
stages.title: Add encoding and validation

invariants: A cache miss cannot change assetVersion or rendition identity.
stages.question: How do most media bytes avoid the central origin?
stages.reason: Make the chosen distribution architecture explicit.
stages.title: Insert an edge cache

invariants: One in-flight fill per immutable key; failed fills wake waiters and can retry boundedly.
stages.question: What happens on a popular cold release?
stages.reason: Collapse misses behind a shield and enforce capability checks before media delivery.
stages.title: Bound origin work and authorize delivery

invariants: Use buffer and throughput hysteresis, not the last single download alone.
stages.question: How is bitrate selected without unbounded prefetch?
stages.reason: Expose the player’s bandwidth estimate and bounded playback buffer.
stages.title: Split adaptation from buffering

invariants: Only identical versioned segments are eligible; corrupt copies are quarantined.
stages.question: Can a failover silently switch to different bytes?
stages.reason: Choose an alternate healthy location while preserving the media contract.
stages.title: Add version-preserving regional failover

invariants: An old playback generation never appends media after a seek.

operations.reason: A seek invalidates all prior fetch callbacks before changing the playback view.

stages.question: Can seek, adaptation and retries publish stale segments?
stages.reason: One generation-aware owner reconciles download, buffer and failover decisions.
stages.title: Merge competing player controllers

solutions.title: Pull-through CDN with an origin shield
tradeoffs: Cold misses incur fill latency and can overload an unprotected origin.
Cache policy and authorization must not leak private media.
